Someone has to check the Stockline contract before anything can be planned. No money moved and no payment is waiting for the CFO. The invoice isn't due until 15 November, so there's time for that check. I didn't sweep the 1.99 in earnings or propose a rebalance, because no agent is blocked.

No action. I didn't plan SLL-2026-11 again because it asks for EUR 2,400 against the EUR 240 fee in code; someone still has to check the contract, and it's not due until 15 Nov. The 1.99 in earnings is less than the other agents may still spend, no agent is blocked, and Alpenweg's EUR 10 shortfall on NW-R-201 is left open and waiting for the CFO.
